title.en: Extending the Term of the Presidential Committee to Study Government Corporations Created Under Executive Order No. 464, Series of 1976
title.orig: Extending the Term of the Presidential Committee to Study Government Corporations Created Under Executive Order No. 464, Series of 1976

text.en:
The Committee is directed to submit its report and recommendations on or before June 30, 1977 and to
oversee the installation and implementation of such of its recommendations as may be approved and adopted
by the appropriate authorities for the period covering July 1, 1977 to December 31, 1977.

An appropriation of P600,000 is authorized for the incurrence of operating and necessary expenditures
in connection with its study of government corporations.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
